name: Duskbat Wing
summary: Duskbats circle Deathknell, and local tailors turn their wings into makeshift armor for newly risen soldiers.

sections.title: Improvised Protection in Deathknell
sections.body: New Forsaken claw from Deathknell’s soil with little more than rags and brittle bones. With mindless Scourge and hostile wildlife nearby, they must gather what protection they can. Novice Elreth, assistant to Shadow Priest Sarvis, collects Duskbat Wings and wolf paws to piece together and strengthen clothing and armor for freshly raised warriors before they enter the wilderness to fight.

faq.q: What are Duskbat Wings used for?
faq.answer: In Deathknell, Novice Elreth uses Duskbat Wings and scavenger paws to make, mend, and strengthen garments and armor for newly awakened Forsaken recruits.

faq.q: Where do Duskbat Wings come from?
faq.answer: Duskbats and Mangy Duskbats in the groves and hills around Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades provide these wings.

faq.q: Who requests these wings in Deathknell?
faq.answer: Novice Elreth asks recruits to gather the wings. She tends the wounded and makes gear under Shadow Priest Sarvis’s direction in the Deathknell chapel.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken rely on bat parts for armor?
faq.answer: Deathknell has almost no supply lines or traditional manufacturing, so local caretakers scavenge hides, fur, and leathery bat wings from Tirisfal’s native predators. They use these materials to make rudimentary protective clothing for recruits heading into combat.

angles.text: As a freshly awakened Forsaken, you gather these wings among your first survival duties, helping keep yourself in one piece during your first skirmishes.
Novice Elreth shows how tailors in Tirisfal use tough bat wings as workable substitutes for leather and fabric.
